about: The frames of the code sprite sprites/village-elder.js (frozen copy at commit 7e328c3, deleted by R2 with rigs/topdown.js), recorded per look and clip: every frame as palette indices (palette[0] is "no pixel"; a pixel with alpha 0 is 0), little-endian 16-bit, deflated, base64. The "" look is the defaults, raw; every other look stores 0 where its pixel equals the defaults look's same pixel of the same clip and index + 1 elsewhere. Looks are the ones of tests/unit/m7-topdown-pixels.test.mjs plus (listed in `extra`) the ones of the gap records, which hold only the clips named. Read through tests/helpers/code-frames.mjs.
